title: [Bug/Feature] Carbs suggestions beeps every 5 mins
symptom: After upgrade to AAPS v3.3.1.2 on daughter's phone, the phone beeps every 5 minutes while getting carbs suggestions, even if the local alarm for carbs is switched off. The alarm switch OFF is not working, and it is annoying especially at night.
fix: The limit for 'Minimum Carbs Required For Suggesstion' was increased to 100 in a commit, which may help by allowing a higher threshold to reduce suggestions.
settings_changed: Minimum Carbs Required For Suggesstion → 100 (max increased from 10 to 100)
